title: Two lanterns and the lamp, unlit
logline: The Grunion Run: two lanterns, and beside the near one, on the sand, the green swing-arm lamp, unlit, brought again. Two years before it's lit. The fish don't care.

panels.composition: A night beach with two lanterns, and beside the near one a green swing-arm desk lamp standing on the sand unlit, a man from behind sitting beside it, the pup at the surf, the fish silver.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, a night beach with two lanterns and an unlit green swing-arm desk lamp standing on the sand beside the nearer one, a man seen from behind sitting beside it, a small three-legged dog at a surf line silver with fish, no words

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run

notes: The lamp unlit, again. Two years before.
